title: Amazon Best Sellers Rank Tracker input

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Amazon department slugs, one per line, e.g. kitchen, electronics, beauty, toys-and-games, sporting-goods, pet-supplies, hpc (health), books. For subcategories, paste URLs below.

categoryUrls.title: List URLs
categoryUrls.description: Any Amazon.com Best Sellers or New Releases URL, including subcategories, e.g. https://www.amazon.com/Best-Sellers-Kitchen-Dining-Bakeware/zgbs/kitchen/289668.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Which Amazon lists to read for each category above.

maxRank.title: Top N
maxRank.description: How deep to read each list (Amazon shows up to 100).

includeSubcategories.title: Include direct subcategories
includeSubcategories.description: Also read every subcategory one level below each category (e.g. Kitchen & Dining -> Bakeware, Cookware...). Each is its own top 100.

fillDetails.title: Fill details for every rank
fillDetails.description: Amazon's list page only shows title, price and rating for about the first 30 ranks; this reads the product page for the rest. Off = those rows have ASIN and rank only.

trackChanges.title: Track rank changes
trackChanges.description: Remember each list's ranks and add previousRank, rankChange and isNewEntry; the run summary lists products that dropped out. History lives in your named key-value store amazon-bestsellers-history.
